name: Project a scenario-driven mission to close an experience gap

userStory.actor: a professional who has chosen a valuable experience gap to close
userStory.intent: turn a market-relevant experience acquisition opportunity into a bounded, scenario-obligated mission
userStory.outcome: see exactly which scenario obligations, in which language embodiment, at which evidence maturity, would close the gap

experience.actor: a professional who has chosen a valuable experience gap to close
experience.promise: I can see the scenario-driven mission that would close my chosen experience gap.

observableConditions.statement: a cataloged target capability projects the scenario obligations required to close the gap
the projected mission retains the market signal and evidence fact ids that justified it
the preferred embodiment is populated exactly when a mission template is declared for the target capability, and null otherwise
